When using the clothing, only the head of the model is required. Using the full body will result in clipping.
(Removing the unseen parts of the body is better of performance as well)

https://quaternius.com/packs/universalbasecharacters.html

The female mannequin doesn’t include the animations, as duplicating them wouldn’t make sense. 
You can easily retarget them from the library files in Blender, or even better, directly in your engine, since both mannequins share the same rig and very similar proportions.

The Unreal Engine models were exported in GLTF because of a known scaling bug when importing rigged FBXs from Blender. It recognizes the units wrong and breaks retargeting in some cases.
Strongly suggest also using GLTF if you want to re-export.

To import just drag and drop the .glTF.
